sdl.description: Inspect and maintain SDL Objective records.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List Objective records in the current checkout.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check one Objective record for required files and Markdown headings.

commands.name: archive
commands.description: Archive or unarchive an Objective record by moving its directory.

commands.name: exec-list-candidates
commands.description: List active Objective slug candidates for shell and agent autocomplete.

commands.name: exec-load-orientations
commands.description: Load active Objective orientation files for agent onboarding.

commands.name: exec-read-objective
commands.description: Read one Objective record by explicit slug as filesystem facts or raw Markdown.

commands.name: exec-runner-begin
commands.description: Check preconditions and emit step facts plus the subagent prompt for one decomposed Objective Runner step (ADR 0024).

commands.name: exec-runner-step
commands.description: Run one verified Objective implementation step through a dispatched child session and emit the Runner Checkpoint.

commands.name: exec-runner-subagent-usage
commands.description: Summarize Pi runner subagent JSONL usage telemetry for Objective stack digests.

commands.name: exec-tracking-gate
commands.description: Collect deterministic Objective tracking gate evidence for one slug.
